title: The water park…first visit last night
content: I’ve seen people here mention the water park and I’ve never been until last night. I was curious if anyone had the same type park but it sort of starts off almost underground but it’s man made. Like a tunnel on a water ride. There is overhead concrete and the water is sort of raging in some areas. You get in a seat or float and there were letters hanging from the ceiling, A B C D E F and they go along the whole way and if say you were a kid and wanted a somewhat smooth ride you’d follow the A’s and so on until F was where it would dunk you and roll you in waves etc. I finally came out in a big cavern and the riders seats assembled in a ring or circle facing inward. About 12. When those were full the water sort of parted and moved back and another larger ring for riders was now visible and so on but I awoke before the that part of the ride started. I then went back to sleep several time I was restless and ended up at the motel, casino and hospital all in one night. Reading here has me thinking and going more again. Fun.
